title: portable-pty crate metadata
claims: portable-pty is published from the WezTerm repository
notes: Candidate identity only; PTY behavior remains to be qualified on each target.

title: Job Objects
claims: a job object manages associated processes as a unit
job operations can enforce limits and terminate associated processes

title: Tokio AbortHandle
claims: AbortHandle terminates a spawned async task without awaiting it
spawn_blocking tasks cannot be aborted once running

title: std::fs::canonicalize
claims: canonicalize returns an absolute path with symbolic links resolved
behavior is platform-specific
notes: Used with rename semantics and operation-boundary checks.

title: Write-Ahead Logging
claims: SQLite WAL is an alternative journal mode
WAL has documented checkpointing, concurrency, and compatibility considerations
notes: WAL is not a backup or target-filesystem durability proof.

title: SQLite Backup API
claims: the online backup API supports copying a live database
external copying has documented consistency and failure limitations
notes: Restore verification remains an application responsibility.

title: keyring crate
claims: keyring offers platform-independent password and secret access on macOS, Windows, and Unix-like platforms
keyring-core is intended for applications that need store-selection control
notes: Credential-store availability and application policy require native qualification.

title: Landlock: unprivileged access control
claims: Landlock restricts ambient filesystem or network rights
rules can restrict a process and its future children
notes: Kernel support and selected ABI must be detected.

title: AppContainer isolation
claims: AppContainer is intended to isolate applications from unneeded resources
access is granted according to least privilege
notes: macOS App Sandbox is a separate product and entitlement model.

title: App Sandbox
claims: Apple documents App Sandbox as a macOS security facility
notes: Exact executor integration was not tested.

title: Wasmtime Security
claims: WebAssembly instances interact with the outside world through explicitly linked imports and exports
Wasmtime documents sandboxing and host API tradeoffs
notes: Host-import policy remains the embedding application's responsibility.

title: MCP Authorization
claims: MCP specifies OAuth-based authorization roles and flow
the specification documents token audience binding, privilege restriction, and redirect considerations
notes: Protocol authorization does not grant local executor authority.

title: Artifact attestations
claims: artifact attestations are cryptographically signed provenance claims
attestations can include an SBOM
notes: Verification must be part of the updater and release gate.

title: Rust Platform Support
claims: Rust target support has tiers with different build and test guarantees
tier 1 targets are built and tested by the Rust project
notes: Compiler target support is not Splyce product conformance.
